_: A seat's portrait (docs/hub/org.md, "A seat's portrait"): one table, two halves. ids: each row is a value as it would be typed after Staff -Portrait or written as a seat's portrait key, and whether it is a portrait -- one of consts.json org.portraits, compared exactly, case included, after the value is trimmed. seats: the tree below, and a row per seat kind with the value given and what follows from consts.json org.portraitSeats, the one rule naming the seats that take a portrait. takes is whether the rule names the seat. present, where a row has it, is the portrait the seat holds before the call (a hand-written one). outcome is what Staff -Seat <seat> -Portrait <value> does: written (the id stored), removed (the empty value, which goes on ANY seat: the key taken away, or nothing written where there is none -- the seat's own default) or refused (exit 2, nothing written) -- refused-id for an id the tool does not draw, refused-seat for an id on a seat the rule does not name, refused-pool for a pool, which has no seat. A reader serves a portrait only where takes is true and the id is valid, and says every other non-empty one once as a warning naming how to remove it, never refusing the file. rules: the rule itself, over a rule given in the row rather than consts.json's, so every half matches an entry and a role file the same way -- exactly, case included -- and a wider rule reads as data. tkTestToolkit -OrgChart asserts Test-P20OrgPortrait, Test-P20OrgTakesPortrait, the reader and Staff over it; Tests/test_org.py asserts is_portrait, takes_portrait and the reader.

ids.why: a value is trimmed, as every other text field is
ids are matched exactly, case included
the owner's own face is the owner seat's default, which is no key at all

seats.kind: VP of product, a stray portrait taken away
PM, a stray portrait kept by another switch

rules.why: widening to the VPs is a rule of three entries, and nothing else
the root is named only by root
an entry is matched exactly, case included
a key of org.roles is matched exactly, case included
a role file is matched exactly, case included
an entry that is neither root nor a role key names no seat
